description: This file implements Windows service management for Kubernetes, including service initialization, handling pre-shutdown events, and controlling service states.

classes.name: handler
classes.description: Struct managing Windows service control events and communication channels.

methods.name: QueryPreShutdownInfo
methods.description: Queries the pre-shutdown timeout information for a Windows service handle.

methods.name: UpdatePreShutdownInfo
methods.description: Updates the pre-shutdown timeout information for a Windows service handle.

methods.name: InitService
methods.description: Starts the service as a Windows service without pre-shutdown support.

methods.name: InitServiceWithShutdown
methods.description: Starts the service as a Windows service with pre-shutdown support.

methods.name: initService
methods.description: Internal function to initialize the Windows service with optional pre-shutdown handling.

methods.name: SetPreShutdownHandler
methods.description: Sets the handler for processing pre-shutdown events.

methods.name: IsServiceInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the service handler has been initialized.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Main loop handling Windows service control requests such as stop, shutdown, and pre-shutdown.
